answer_1.quote: We run extensive experiments with 5 question-answering tasks spanning different domains and scenarios; 5 open-source LLMs ... 2 closed-source models ... and 3 testing scenarios (zero-shot with prompting, full fine-tuning and LoRA fine-tuning).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model's performance using recall, which indicates the number of words (excluding punctuation) from the gold answer that also appear in the model prediction.
